title: Woman in Fur Coat and Headscarf, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length black and white snapshot dated November 28, 1947, depicting a stylishly dressed woman standing outdoors in front of a house with horizontal siding. She is wearing a winter coat trimmed with fur, a patterned scarf tied under her chin, white gloves, black heels, and holding a small handbag. The photograph showcases cold-weather women's fashion from post-World War II America.
